title: File:Margaritaville at Sea Islander in November 2024 (cropped).jpg
description: Margaritaville at Sea Islander alongside a pier, stern-quarter view: the light-blue hull with the Margaritaville at Sea mark and the name Islander on the stern (Nassau registry), lifeboats and the palm-tree funnel visible, Carnival Valor and a Princess ship berthed astern. Photographed 27 November 2024 by Bassfish22; the cropped derivative on Commons was uploaded by HenSti.
